id.description: BILL-generated ID of the payment. The value begins with `stp`.

vendorId.description: BILL-generated ID of the vendor to be paid. The value begins with `009`.

billId.description: BILL-generated ID of the bill to be paid. The value begins with `00n`.

billPayments.description: List of bill payments. When a payment is applied to a bill, the bill payment is identified by a bill payment `id`. The value begins with `blp`.

description.description: Bill payment description. This value is included in the check memo or in the bank descriptor for electronic payments.

processDate.description: Payment process date in the `yyyy-MM-dd` format. On this date, BILL starts processing the payment and starts withdrawing funds from the sender's funding account.

amount.description: Payment amount. For a payment in an international currency (not USD), this value is in the local currency.

transactionNumber.description:
Payment transaction reference used as an external identifier.

You can set this field as a unique alphanumeric value for your system to track the payment transaction. The value must be 50 characters or fewer. If you do not set `transactionNumber`, BILL sets this field as a unique alphanumeric payment identification value.

exchangeRate.description: Exchange rate for the payment in an international currency (not USD)

onlinePayment.description:
Payment source.
* `true`: Payment is made with BILL (online)
* `false`: Payment is made outside BILL and then recorded in BILL (offline)

allOf.description: Disbursement type. This value is set when you create a payment. See `disbursementInfo` for information about the disbursement method used when BILL processes your payment.

remittanceEmail.description: Remittance email address set for the vendor

createdBy.description: BILL-generated ID of the user that created the payment. The value begins with `006`.

allOf.description:
Payment disbursement information. This information is based on the disbursement method used when BILL processes your payment.

For example, when BILL processes an ACH payment, `disbursementInfo` includes the `sentDate` and `arrivesByDate` fields.

cancelRequestSubmitted.description:
This field is set as `true` if a cancel payment request is submitted.

**Note**: If the payment is cancelled, the payment `status` is set as `CANCELLED`.

allOf.description:
Unified payment status. This field provides BILL payment lifecycle updates based on the `status` and `disbursementStatus` values in the response.

See [Single status payment values](https://developer.bill.com/docs/single-status-payment-values) in the Guides section for the list of available values.

AchDisbursement.description: ACH disbursement dto when the disbursement type is ach.

id.description: BILL-generated ID of the bill payment. The value begins with `blp`.

billId.description: BILL-generated ID of the bill to be paid. The value begins with `00n`.

amount.description: Payment amount. For a payment in an international currency (not USD), this value is in the local currency.

vendorCredits.description: Vendor credits applied to the bill payment

trackingInformation.description: UPS tracking number for the check. You get a tracking number only for a BILL Pay Faster check payment.

CheckDisbursement.description: Check disbursement dto when the disbursement type is check.

isVoidable.description: Set as `true` if the payment disbursement type can be voided

allOf.description: ACH payment to verified national vendor disbursement information

DisbursementStatus.description: The enum type for disbursement status.

allOf.description:
Payment funding type.
* `BANK_ACCOUNT`: Bank account
* `CARD_ACCOUNT`: Credit card or debit card
* `WALLET`: BILL balance
* `AP_CARD`: AP Card

See the BILL Help FAQ sections for [BILL balance](https://help.bill.com/direct/s/article/4409933681677) and [AP Card](https://help.bill.com/direct/s/article/000003348) for more information.

id.description: BILL-generated ID of the selected payment funding type. For the `WALLET` type, the `id` is not required.

FundingAccountResponse.description: Funding account details in Payments API.

FundingAccountTypeResponse.description: Funading account type for Payments API.

allOf.description: Payment delivery method for making the International ePayment

InternationalDisbursement.description: International disbursement dto when the disbursement type is international.

id.description: BILL-generated ID of the vendor credit applied to the bill payment. The value begins with `vcr`.

requestPayFaster.description:
Set as `true` to use BILL Pay Faster. This field is required if `requestCheckDeliveryType` is set.

  See [Payments](https://developer.bill.com/docs/ap-payments)   in the Guides section for information about BILL Pay Faster payments.

createBill.description:
* Set as `false` to create a vendor payment for an existing bill.
* Set as `true` to create a bill for a vendor payment. If `createBill` is `true`, do not set `billId` in your payment request.

allOf.description: BILL Pay Faster payment delivery type. The `RTP_DELIVERY` option is not available for vendor payments by check.

ProcessingOptionsResponse.description: User provided options for processing the payments request.

sentDate.description: ACH payment to verified national vendor sent date

arrivesByDate.description: ACH payment to verified national vendor arrives by date

traceNumber.description: Payment trace number. This value is used to uniquely identify a payment in a batch.

RppsDisbursement.description: Rpps disbursement dto when the disbursement type is ACH to verified national vendor.

arrivesByDate.description: Virtual card payment arrives by date

validUntil.description: Date until when the card is valid

VcardDisbursement.description: Virtual card disbursement dto when the disbursement type is virtual card.

id.description: BILL-generated ID of the void payment request. The value begins with `vrq`.

requestedBy.description: BILL-generated ID of the user that requested a void payment. The value begins with `006`.

createdTime.description: Void payment request created date and time

updatedTime.description: Void payment request updated date and time

VoidInfo.description: Void information for the Payments DTO.

arrivesByDate.description: Instant Transfer (wallet) payment arrives by date

WalletDisbursement.description: Wallet disbursement dto when the disbursement type is wallet.
